Only text files and snapshots land here - the whole folder is the report:
  scan_log.csv        text log, one line per scan, rotates at 10 MB
  session.txt         what the app found at start (monitors, game window,
                      search area, capture path, game log, blueprint library)
  region_config.txt   a copy of your settings
  snapshot_*.png/.txt only after Ctrl+Alt+S, fifty at most
